DEED OF PARTNERSHIP 
 
 This Deed of Partnership (“ Partnership Deed ”) is made at Lahore on this 28 th day of December, 2020 by and between: 
 
 Earthlink Develop ments LLP having its registered place of business at First Floor, Plaza No. 37, Ascon Heights, Civic Centre, Phase IV, Bahria Town, Islamabad through its authorized representative Muhammad Mub u sher Hayat s /o Tahir Hayat , holder of CNIC No. 61101-1251917-5 (hereinafter “ First Partner ”) 
 
 AND 
 
 Zameen Axis (private) Limited having its registered place of business at Pearl One, Third Floor, 94/B - 1 Gulberg III, Lahore through its authorized representative Zeeshan Ali Khan s/o Shahid Ali Khan CNIC No. 35201-6487663-3 (hereinafter “ Second Partner ”) 
 
 
 [Each a “ Partner ” or “ Party ”, and collectively, “ Partners ” or “ Parties ”] 
 
 WHEREAS , the Partners have agreed to enter into a mutually beneficial partnership, and have represented to each other that they have the relevant expertise, knowledge and financial capability, to develop and construct a mixed-use real estate project in Bahria Tow n , Rawalpindi and have agreed to execute this Deed on the following terms and conditions. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, THIS DEED OF PARTNERSHIP WITNESSES AS UNDER: 
 
 Partnership and Business 
 
 Name of Partnership 
 The Partnership shall be carried out under the name and style of “ EDZD Developers ”, or under any other name as may be mutually decided between the Partners ( “Partnership” ). 
 
 Business 
 The Partnership shall inter alia carry-on business as real estate developers, to construct and develop a mixed-use real estate project and to purchase Plot No 95-E situated in Bahria Paradise commercial, Bahria Town Phase 6, G.T. Road, Rawalpindi measuring 4.78 Kanals, for this purpose, or any other business as mutually decided in writing between the Parties from time to time (“ Business ”). 
 
 Place of Business 
 
 The principal place of business of the Partnership shall be the office of the Second Partner, specifically 94-B/1, M.M Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, or at any other place as mutually agreed, from time to time, in writing between the Parties. 
 
 Joint Ownership of the Name of the Partnership 
 The Parties are the founding partners of the Partnership and shall together have exclusive ownership of the name of the Partnership for all purposes, including goodwill and any intellectual property associated therewith. 
 
 Duration 
 The Business of the Partnership shall be deemed to have commenced on the date first written above ( “Effective Date” ) and shall continue until dissolved as provided for in this Deed. 
 
 Capital Contribution, Profit Sharing, and Accounting 
 
 Share of Profits and Losses 
 
 The profit and loss sharing ratio of the Partners in the Partnership shall be as specified in Table-I below , and all profits and losses of the Partnership including capital profits and losses, if any, shall be divided and borne by the Partners in the same percentage as stated in this Clause 2.1. 
 
 TABLE – I 
 
 S. No. 
 Description 
 Share in Partnership in Percentage 
 1 
 First Partner 
 50 
 2 
 Second Partner 
 50 
 
 Capital Contribution 
 
 Any capital requirements of the Partnership shall, unless otherwise mutually agreed between the Partners in writing, be contributed by the Partners in the same percentage as the ir profit and loss sharing ratio for the time being credited to them and stated in Clause 2.1 above . 
 
 Salaries 
 
 Unless otherwise mutually agreed in writing between all Partners, no Partner shall receive any salary for services rendered to the Partnership. 
 
 Accounts 
 
 Proper accounts of the Partnership shall be maintained. Books of accounts and all supporting documents shall not be removed ordinarily from the place of Business. The Partners shall have equal rights and access to and shall, at all reasonable times, be entitled to examine and take copies of the books of accounts and supporting documents. 
 
 A bi-annual general account shall be taken every six (6) months of all the assets and liabilities, profits and losses of the Partnership (including profits or losses incurred but not actually received or paid out) for the preceding six (6) months and shall be signed by the Partners. All accounts signed shall be conclusive and final between the Partners as to all matters stated therein, unless some manifest error is discovered in the following general account, in which case such error shall be rectified. 
 
 An external auditor shall be hired on written mutual agreement between the Partners to conduct the bi-annual general account. 
 
 If on taking of the bi-annual general account the drawings of any Partner during the corresponding six (6) months are found to exceed the share in the profits for such period, such Partner shall refund the excess immediately to the Partnership. 
 
 Management of the Partnership 
 
 Performance 
 
 The Partners shall jointly and/or severally carry on the business of the Partnership, for the common benefit of the Partnership and shall be just and faithful to each other in all their dealings and transactions in the Partnership business and shall render true accounts and full information regarding all matters of the Partnership. The Partners will at all times diligently and faithfully employ themselves in the conduct and management of the Business of the Partnership, and use their best endeavors to promote and beneficially extend the same. 
 
 Resolution of the Partners 
 
 The powers of the Partners may be exercised by a meeting of the Partners, the minutes whereof shall be duly recorded and signed by each Partner, or by a written resolution consented to by the signatures of the Partners. Without limiting the matters required at law to be determined by resolutions of the Partners, the following shall require the written consent of all Partners: 
 
 Investment in any other company/entity or other body corporate; 
 Any capital expenditure exceeding Rs. [ ● ] , or such other amount determined by the Partners, or any proposal to alter the limits set-out in this sub-clause (b) of Clause 3.2 ; 
 Any disposal by sale, pledge, mortgage or otherwise any part of the Partnership or its assets/property; 
 A ny borrowings or other financial accommodation including any loan, overdraft, etc. in the name of the Partnership or for the purposes of the Partnership or utilizing assets owned by the Partnership as collateral or security for such loans; 
 Entering into any leases for the Partnership of movable or immovable property or any variations or amendments to such arrangements; 
 Any loans or other financial accommodation extended by the Partnership, or the payment of any money, to: 
 Any Partner, except as expressly provided for in this Deed; or 
 Any third party, including employees. 
 The Partnership entering into or becoming liable under any surety or guarantee or similar arrangement under which the Partnership may incur any liability, in respect of the financial obligation of the Partnership, any Partner or third party; 
 The creation of any encumbrance, charge or lien over any asset of the Partnership; 
 Assigning, selling or charging the interest of any Partner; 
 Ordering any goods or services for the Partnership's own account which are either not in the Partnership’s ordinary product range or cost, such amount to be reviewed annually, or such other amount determined by the Partners; 
 Any decision to commence, defend or compromise any litigation or other similar procedure; 
 The merger or acquisition of or by the Partnership with respect to any other business or entity; 
 Any deviation from any Business, marketing, sales, construction plan or any other plan relevant to the Business of the Partnership approved by the Partners in writing; 
 Any change in the basis of accounting or in the Partnership’s accounting policy . 
 
 Consent 
 
 No Partner shall, without the written consent of the remaining Partners: 
 
 Incur any liability or lend any monies or give credit on behalf of the Partnership; 
 Execute any guarantee or security against the property of the Partnership or become guarantor or surety for any person or go or knowingly suffer anything whereby the Partnership property may be endangered; 
 Enter into any bond or become surety for any persons or permit or suffer to be done anything whereby the Partnership property may be taken in execution or otherwise endangered; 
 Assign mortgage or charge her/his share in the Partnership or any part thereof or enter into partnership with any other person concerning such share or any part thereof; or 
 Compromise or compound or exempt upon payment in full, release or discharge any debt due to the Partnership. 
 
 Each Partner shall punctually pay and discharge his separate debts and engagements and indemnify the other Partners and the Partnership assets against the same and all proceedings, costs, claims or demands in respect thereof. 
 
 Decision-Making 
 
 Subject to Clause 3.2 and 3.3 , all remaining decisions of the Partners related to the day-to-day affairs of the Business must be unanimous, and shall be recorded either through e-mail, or in a minute book duly signed by all Partners if deemed necessary, and shall include inter alia the following matters: 
 
 Recruitment of personnel for the daily running of the Business, such as chief financial officer, project manager and coordinator and sales representatives; 
 Appointment or removal of the external auditor of the Partnership; 
 Outsourcing of certain Business activities, such as sales, marketing and construction; and 
 Disbursal of funds and profits. 
 
 Provided that, where a Partner is under a conflict of interest with respect to any decision of the Business, such Partner shall as soon as reasonably practicable inform the other Partner of the existence of the conflict. 
 
 Fiduciary Duties 
 
 Each Partner hereby acknowledges that she/he is a fiduciary of the other and that each has a fiduciary duty of care in undertaking the obligations contained in this Partnership Deed and a duty of loyalty to the Partnership to act in its best interest. 
 
 Property 
 
 All property purchased or lease-hold rights acquired for the purposes of carrying out the Business in terms of the provisions of this Deed shall be in the name and ownership of the Partnership and shall constitute the property of the Partnership. This property shall include both immovable and movable property, including inter alia books, electronics, furniture and other office equipment. 
 
 Bank Account 
 
 Bank account(s) shall be opened in the name of the Partnership with any bank or banks and shall be operated by the Partnership in such manner as mutually agreed between the Partners in writing. 
 
 Debts 
 
 Each Partner shall punctually pay and discharge his separate debts and engagements and indemnify the other Partner and the Partnership assets against the same and all proceedings, costs, claims, or demands in respect thereof. 
 
 Changes in Partnership 
 
 New Partner(s) 
 
 New partner(s) may be inducted into the Partnership by the Partners only by written mutual agreement between the Partners and on such conditions as may be collectively and unanimously agreed between the Partners in the form of a written and signed resolution. 
 
 Retirement 
 
 Either Partner may retire from the Partnership on such terms and conditions and having such consequences as mutually agreed in writing between the Partners. 
 
 Insolvency or Dissolution 
 
 In the event of insolvency or dissolution of a Partner , the Partnership may be dissolved or the surviving Partner may carry on the Business of the Partnership in accordance with the terms and conditions mutually agreed in writing between the Partners . 
 
 Law, Jurisdiction and Arbitration 
 
 Arbitration 
 
 Any dispute, controversy or claim arising out of or relating to this Deed shall be finally settled through arbitration under the Arbitration Act, 1940. The seat of arbitration shall be Lahore. The language of arbitration shall be English. The award of such arbitration proceedings shall be final and binding on all the Partners. Notwithstanding the aforesaid, a Partner shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief from a court of competent jurisdiction. 
 
 Governing Law and Jurisdiction 
 
 This Deed shall be governed by the laws of Pakistan and with the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Lahore. 
 
 General Provisions 
 
 Limited Liability 
 
 No Partner (or their respective agents, officers, directors, members, managers, partners, shareholders or employees) shall be liable to the Partnership or to the other Partners for damages or otherwise with respect to any acts or omissions relating to the Partnership, except to the extent any related loss results from fraud, gross negligence or willful or malicious misconduct on the part of such Partner (or their respective agents, officers, directors, members, managers, partners, shareholders or employees) or the willful breach of any obligation under this Deed. Provided that, no Partner (or their respective agents, officers, directors, members, managers, partners, shareholders or employees) shall have any liability for failing to take any action requiring the consent of a Partner if such Partner fails to grant such consent. 
 
 Indemnification by Partnership 
 
 The Partnership shall indemnify, hold harmless and defend each Partner from and against any loss, expense, damage or injury suffered or sustained by them (including but not limited to any judgment, award, settlement, reasonable attorneys’ fees and other costs or expenses incurred in connection with the defence of any actual or threatened action, proceeding or claim) by reason of or arising out of (i) their activities on behalf of the Partnership or in furtherance of the interests of the Partnership; (ii) their status as a Partner; or (iii) the Partnership’s assets, property, Business or affairs (including, without limitation, the actions of any officer, director, member or employee of the Partnership or any of its Subsidiaries), provided that the acts or omissions were not performed or omitted fraudulently or as a result of gross negligence, willful or malicious misconduct, or willful breach of any obligation under this Deed by such Partner.   
 
 Indemnification by Partners 
 
 Each Partner shall at all times duly and punctually pay and discharge her/his separate and private debts and engagements whether present or future and keep indemnified and hold harmless each other Partner and their representatives, estates and successors, the Partnership and its assets, from all actions, proceedings, costs, claims and demands in respect of such private debts and engagements. Each Partner further agrees to indemnify and hold harmless each other Partner, from and against all liabilities, losses and costs of any kind which relate to such Partner’s misrepresentation, willful illegal acts or omissions, negligence and breach of duty. The obligation to indemnify shall include all reasonable costs and expenses, including but not limited to disbursements and legal fees. The obligation to indemnify shall not include indirect, exemplary or punitive damages of any nature. 
 
 Notices 
 
 Any notice required to be given hereunder shall be in writing and duly served within 24 hours of being sent via email, or within 48 hours of being sent via registered mail to the address of the Partner written above or the last known address. 
 
 Severability 
 
 If any provision of this Deed is prohibited by or adjudged by a court to be unlawful, void or unenforceable such provision shall, to the extent required, be severed and rendered ineffective as far as possible without modifying the remaining provisions hereof and shall not in any way affect any other provisions or validity of this Deed. 
 
 Amendment 
 
 This Deed may be amended only by mutual consent of all Partners given in written and duly signed resolution of the Partners. 
 
 Interpretation 
 
 Title and heading of sections of this Deed are for convenience of reference only and are not intended to define, limit or describe the scope or intent of any provision hereof, and shall not affect the construction of any provision of this Deed. 
 
 Entirety 
 
 This Deed, any minutes of the meeting of the Partners and any other terms and conditions agreed in writing by the Partners from time to time shall constitute the entire agreement and understanding between the Parties with respect to the subject matter contained in this Deed. This Deed, as from the Effective Date, supersedes all prior written or oral representations, negotiations, or other communications or understandings of every kind pertaining to the formation and operation of the Partnership. 
 Authority 
 
 Nothing in this Deed shall be construed to give any Partner(s), and no Partner shall hold itself out to have, the authority or power to enter into any obligation on behalf of the other Partner(s) except as specifically authorized herein or mutually by all Partner(s) in writing. 
 
 Counterparts 
 
 In the event that this Deed is executed in counterparts, each shall be treated as original and together shall be considered one. 
 
 
 SIGNATORIES 
 (DEED OF PARTNERSHIP) 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF , the Partners have set their respective hands on the day and place first hereinabove mentioned
